neighbours.label: the bare opening piece ' ch' or ' Ch' of a word split by the tokenizer (ch|ipped, ch|itin, Ch|andra, ch|ainer, French ch|aise). Whole-token words and other opening pieces stay quiet
fire: The teacher wrote with chalk on the chipped board.
Elle a un chat et une chaise dans la cuisine.
Data from Chandra show a bright ring of gas.
We import chainer to build the model.
The shell of a crab contains chitin and lime.
He kept chrysanthemums along the fence.
Les enfants prennent une chaise dans la salle.
The Chandra observatory has mapped many clusters.
quiet: The teacher wrote with ink on the cracked board.
Elle a un lit et une table dans la cuisine.
Data from Hubble show a bright ring of gas.
We import torch to build the model.
The shell of a crab contains calcium and lime.
He kept tulips along the fence.
Les enfants prennent une table dans la salle.
The Spitzer observatory has mapped many clusters.

notes: Card: ' ch' x8, ' Ch' x8, 'Ch' x2; top single example is ' S' of SNE, and '.s', ' V', 'J' occur, so ' ch' is only part of the pole. Probes: 'Chandra' 0.636, 'chaise' 0.507, 'chainer' 0.469, 'chitin' 0.397, 'chipped' 0.380; 'Chilean and Chinese' 0.031 (whole tokens), 'shale' 0.006, 'Hubble' 0.081.
